messages:
Rina: opened a small PR to tidy SOC2-related language on audit exports and add a migration note for older SDK usage. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/912
Carlos: quick legal flag 1: avoid absolute deletion promises. suggested: 'retained consistent with our documented retention policy and applicable law.'
Ben: engineering note: legacy SDKs used `retention_days`; new SDK uses `retention_policy` (string). i'll add both examples and a tiny compatibility diff.
Alyssa: add a single-line note about redaction: customers can request exports with redaction applied. keep it high level, no internal infra details.
Rina: adding all suggested edits. including a migration code diff and a short troubleshooting bullet for 403s (check tenant export roles).
Ben: proposed snippets to include (compact):
```
# Python (new SDK)
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_API_KEY'))
resp = client.audit.export(tenant_id='acct-99', retention_policy='audit:90d', redacted=True)
print(resp.url)

# Legacy (migration)
# before: resp = client.audit.export(tenant_id='acct-99', retention_days=90)
# after:  resp = client.audit.export(tenant_id='acct-99', retention_policy='audit:90d')
```
Rina: added Carlos' legal phrasing, Alyssa's redaction note, and a cross-ref to the SOC2 FAQ. added a PR checklist item: run SDK snippet smoke test in CI.
docs-bot: Preview published: https://docs.redwood.ai/previews/912/export-policy-migration expires in 7 days.
Carlos: +1 pending final legal pass (quick review).
Alyssa: LGTM from docs. please avoid any mention of backend storage or key names.
Rina: done. merging after legal sign-off and CI smoke test. thanks!
